I found two free drop-in options in Halton Hills that suit a toddler. I didn't pick the gymnastics centre's preschool drop-in because it costs $15.

- **Kids & Me:** 
Halton Region describes it as a free weekly 1.5-hour parenting and early learning drop-in program for families with babies or children up to 6 years of age.
 
The groups follow the school calendar, starting the second week of September.
 The Acton and Georgetown times above are from the Halton Region page.
- **EarlyON (Links2Care):** 
Links2Care offers free programs, activities and resources in Halton Halls for children from birth to their 6th birthday and their parents or caregivers.
 
It runs on weekdays, weekends and evenings, in person, as drop-in, registered and online sessions.
 Their Acton location is the 
Acton Halton Hills Public Library, 17 River Street
. I couldn't read the current day and time schedule off their page, so I've left the `when` blank for that pick.
